say:1:1029422001:1.text: What can I do for you this time, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:1:1029422001:1.male: What can I do for you this time, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:1:1029422001:1.female: What can I do for you this time, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:2:1029422002:1.text: You can't still be asking about the business with the Faith Stone, right?
say:2:1029422002:1.source_cn: 你们该不会还是来问关于圣石的事情的吧？

say:3:1029422003:1.text: Nope! The Detective Fay Squad has already thoroughly investigated the case of the stolen Faith Stone!
say:3:1029422003:1.source_cn: 不是啦。关于圣石失窃案，菲侦探小队已经彻底调查完毕了！

say:4:1029422004:1.text: And we came to a surprising conclusion...
say:4:1029422004:1.source_cn: 而且我们还得出了一个惊人的结论——

choice_prompt:5:1029422004.text: And we came to a surprising conclusion...
choice_prompt:5:1029422004.source_cn: 而且我们还得出了一个惊人的结论——

say:6:1029422005:1.text: That's right! This might all be a scheme of the Adamant Syndicate, with the purpose of opening the Hypogean Rift and releasing the terrible Hypogeans!
say:6:1029422005:1.source_cn: 没错！这一切可能都是黑金商会布的局，目的就是为了打开恶...

say:7:1029422006:1.text: The Syndicate...? Now that I think about it, despite how long it's been, it makes sense.
say:7:1029422006:1.source_cn: 黑金商会吗……仔细想想，虽然时间久远，但好像也挺有道理。

say:8:1029422007:1.text: In fact, even after stealing the Faith Stone, I had my doubts countless times. Everything seemed to go too smoothly, almost as if it were planned...
say:8:1029422007:1.source_cn: 其实在偷完圣石之后，我也曾无数次地怀疑过……当时的一切...

say:9:1029422008:1.text: Later, I even tried to track down the Faith Stone myself, and you know that treasure hunters always have contacts from all over.
say:9:1029422008:1.source_cn: 后面我也尝试着追踪过圣石的消息，你们知道的，寻宝猎人总...

say:10:1029422009:1.text: I discovered something unexpected—that there was another piece of the Faith Stone hidden in the Temple. That was when I realized that something was terribly wrong.
say:10:1029422009:1.source_cn: 通过一些方式，我也得知了一个意外信息——原来圣堂里也藏...

choice_prompt:11:1029422009.text: I discovered something unexpected—that there was another piece of the Faith Stone hidden in the Temple. That was when I realized that something was terribly wrong.
choice_prompt:11:1029422009.source_cn: 通过一些方式，我也得知了一个意外信息——原来圣堂里也藏有一块圣石。从那个时候开始，我就意识到，这一切都非常不对劲。

say:12:1029422010:0.text: Correct. I knew that the Faith Stones would react to each other... If Temesia approached the Sun Temple, everything I'd tried to hide would be exposed.
say:12:1029422010:0.source_cn: 没错。我知道圣石之间会产生感应现象……如果特弥希娅靠近...

say:13:1029422011:1.text: Given her nature, it wouldn't have been easy for her to know the truth... though I guess it couldn't stay hidden forever. But I suppose this result is as good as it gets.
say:13:1029422011:1.source_cn: 依照她的性格，知道真相之后一定会很不好受……虽然最后也...

say:16:1029422013:2.text: Yes. It's time for us to move on.
say:16:1029422013:2.source_cn: 是啊。我们也是时候该向前看了。毕竟，我们的人生还有很长...

say:17:1029422014:1.text: That's right! The process might have been painful, but the result is still beautiful. And... the first case of the Detective Fay Squad is successfully closed!
say:17:1029422014:1.source_cn: 没错没错！虽然过程有些曲折，但是结果还是很美好的嘛。以...

say:18:1029422015:1.text: Wow, it looks like we really did uncover a remarkable truth! We're pretty good!
say:18:1029422015:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这儿看来，我们还真是调查出了一个了不得的真相啊！...

say:20:1029422016:1.text: Obviously, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> did most of the work! Your reasoning was full of holes!
say:20:1029422016:1.male: Obviously, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> did most of the work! Your reasoning was full of holes!
say:20:1029422016:1.female: Obviously, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> did most of the work! Your reasoning was full of holes!

say:21:1029422017:0.text: That's because the magister is so awesome! Not just at magic, but detective work too!
say:21:1029422017:0.source_cn: 那是因为老师太厉害了！果然，不只是在魔法方面，老师在侦...
say:21:1029422017:0.male: That's because the magister is so awesome! Not just at magic, but detective work too!
say:21:1029422017:0.female: That's because the magister is so awesome! Not just at magic, but detective work too!

say:22:1029422018:1.text: I'll try to look into this matter from within the Temple later, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:22:1029422018:1.male: I'll try to look into this matter from within the Temple later, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:22:1029422018:1.female: I'll try to look into this matter from within the Temple later, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:23:1029422019:1.text: Apart from that, I'll be at your disposal whenever you need to fight Hypogeans.
say:23:1029422019:1.source_cn: 除此之外，当您需要对抗恶魔时，我将随时听从召唤。
say:23:1029422019:1.male: Apart from that, I'll be at your disposal whenever you need to fight Hypogeans.
say:23:1029422019:1.female: Apart from that, I'll be at your disposal whenever you need to fight Hypogeans.

say:25:1029422020:1.text: Call on me too, in that case. someone's gotta keep an eye on Temesia!
say:25:1029422020:1.source_cn: 既然如此，也叫上我吧，我得看着点特弥希娅。
say:25:1029422020:1.male: Call on me too, in that case. someone's gotta keep an eye on Temesia!
say:25:1029422020:1.female: Call on me too, in that case. someone's gotta keep an eye on Temesia!

say:26:1029422021:1.text: I-I may not be of too much use, but I'm still willing to help!
say:26:1029422021:1.source_cn: 我、我虽然可能还派不上太大用场，但我也会来帮忙的！
say:26:1029422021:1.male: I-I may not be of too much use, but I'm still willing to help!
say:26:1029422021:1.female: I-I may not be of too much use, but I'm still willing to help!

choice:15:0:1.text: It's all in the past now.
choice:15:0:1.male: It's all in the past now.
choice:15:0:1.female: It's all in the past now.

choice:11:0:1.text: So you prevented Temesia from going.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 所以你阻止特弥希娅去日神殿
choice:11:0:1.male: So you prevented Temesia from going.
choice:11:0:1.female: So you prevented Temesia from going.

choice:11:1:2.text: You knew she couldn't go near there.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 你知道特弥希娅不能靠近日神殿
choice:11:1:2.male: You knew she couldn't go near there.
choice:11:1:2.female: You knew she couldn't go near there.

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 圣石失窃案可能和黑金商会有关
